subject.title: build(deps): bump the android-deps group across 1 directory with 2 updates

question: Should this shared Kotlin compiler-plugin upgrade merge after the Android validation matrix passes, or should the Android owner hold it for additional compatibility investigation?
rationale: The diff is mechanically narrow, but its shared catalog alias affects the Compose and serialization Gradle plugins, so maintainer acceptance is needed for the upgrade risk rather than a code rewrite.

options.title: Merge after Android validation
options.body: Accept the upgrade once the Android build, test, and ktlint lanes show that the project resolves and builds against Kotlin 2.4.10.

options.title: Hold for compatibility review
options.body: Pause the update if Android-area owners need additional device, plugin, or release compatibility evidence beyond the matrix.

recommendation.title: Merge after Android validation
recommendation.body: Accept the upgrade once the Android build, test, and ktlint lanes show that the project resolves and builds against Kotlin 2.4.10.
